{{Quote|The Imperial mandate also demanded that Helix operators register their craft with the ISB and modify their ship to ensure compliance with the Safe Starship Regulations|C-D20 explains the mandate effecting the ''Helix''-class light interceptor|<ref name="ABGTAS">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}, p. 72</ref>}}
The '''Safe Starship Regulations''' were a set of regulations which limited the strength and number of armaments that a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] could have built into it. After the release of the heavily armed [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] mandate was released by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] ordering any [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had purchased an interceptor to modify it to fit within the Safe Starship Regulations. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-D20]] mentioned the regulations effecting the ''Helix'' class when he described the ship to a [[Unidentified Rebel (hangar)|member]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] looking for a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to use in their next mission.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Safe Starship Regulations were first mentioned in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]].
